content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Customer Support. My name is Mark. Before we begin, could you please confirm your full name and the email address associated with your Amazon account for verification purposes?
Yes, it's Sarah Gleason. The email is sarah.gleason79@gmail.com.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm reviewing your account now. I do see a recent order flagged for delayed processing due to an unresolved compliance check. Let me assure you, this is a standard part of our anti-fraud initiative for customer safety.
Oh, I see. Is this about the headphones I ordered last week? I've been worried because I'm on unemployment right now and can't afford to lose any money.

Yes, it relates to your recent headphones order. I completely understand your concerns, especially during these challenging times. We're here to assist you and make sure your order is processed smoothly.
Sarah, as per Amazon's updated compliance policy, high-value shipments are subject to a temporary regulatory fee, which is fully refundable. This is to ensure all orders meet customs and tax regulations before delivery can proceed. May I ask, have you received any previous notifications regarding this policy?
No, I haven't seen anything about this. Is this new? I just want to make sure I'm not getting scammed.

Your caution is absolutely valid, Sarah. This procedure was introduced recently due to regulatory changes affecting online shipments. To confirm, you will not lose any funds, the fee is held temporarily and released back to your original payment method within 24 hours after verification.
Okay, but what do I need to do?

We will process your compliance through our secure channel. For your order amount, the temporary regulatory fee is $180. Due to third-party restrictions, the fastest method is via Amazon-approved eGift Cards. Are you able to access an online retailer or pharmacy to purchase Amazon eGift Cards today?
I can check, but that's a lot of money for me. Why can't you just charge my card like before?

I realize it's an inconvenience, and I apologize. Unfortunately, our payment gateway is temporarily restricted due to the compliance audit; this is why we're using eGift Cards as a secure, trackable alternative. You will receive a full refund after verification.
How many cards do I need? Do I just buy one for $180?

You can purchase either one $180 Amazon eGift Card or two cards totaling $180, whichever is more convenient for you. Please ensure the cards are activated at the register and retain your purchase receipt for confirmation.
Alright. If I do this, what do I do with the cards?
Once you have purchased the eGift Cards, please provide the redemption codes here. This will allow us to verify compliance and immediately release your order for shipping.
Do I need to scratch off something or are the codes on the receipt?

If you buy physical cards, gently scratch off the silver strip on the back to reveal the code. For emailed or digital cards, the code will be in the email confirmation. Please send me the codes, and also let me know the last four digits of the order number for verification.
Okay, I found the order email. The last four digits are 9032. I'm heading to the store now.
Thank you for confirming. Please let me know as soon as you have the cards, as we have a limited time window to resolve this before your order is returned to sender.
I just bought two $90 cards. Here are the codes: AG4P-XX7L-9Q2Q and B9ND-TR5P-7ML8. What happens next?
Thank you, Sarah. I am submitting the codes to our compliance team now. While that is processing, could you please confirm your phone number so we can contact you directly if needed?

Perfect, thank you. Please allow 5-10 minutes for processing. If there are any issues with the codes, I will let you know. Rest assured, your refund and order release will be prioritized as soon as compliance clears your payment.
Alright. I'm a bit nervous still, but I hope this works.

Understandable, Sarah. I appreciate your patience and cooperation. If you need confirmation at any time, I can provide a transaction reference number for your records. Please stay on this chat for updates.
